questions.question: What does Psalm 133 celebrate?
options: How lovely indeed is your dwelling place, O LORD of hosts
How long, O LORD, will you forget me forever?
How good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity
How majestic is your name in all the earth
questions.answer: How good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity

questions.question: To what is unity compared?
options: Fresh dew on the grass, glistening in the dawn
Sweet honey from the comb, dripping from the rock
Precious oil on the head, running down the beard
Fine wine in the cup, gladdening the heart
questions.answer: Precious oil on the head, running down the beard

questions.question: The psalm says that there the LORD has commanded the blessing, life forevermore.
Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in _____!
It is like the dew of Hermon, which falls on the mountains of _____.
